jobs.description:
JOB FOCUS 
 
  The incumbent is responsible for the processes on archiving completeness and transport document compliance for documents related to Global Logistics shipments. The incumbent drives process automation and process outsourcing to ensure timely and correct execution of compliance and completeness checks of transport documents. 
 
  The incumbent orchestrates and coordinates activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders to recover missing documentation and/or correct any issues identified. Stakeholder forums are set up and driven by the incumbent to focus on issue resolution and Continuous Improvement in the space of archiving completeness and documentation compliance. Leveraging digital tools and new technologies are focus areas. 
 
  Partnership is fostered with key cross-functional stakeholders impacted by or contributing to the processes in scope of the role (including amongst other Indirect Tax, Digital, Quality, Transportation, outsourced services partner and external transport service providers). 
 
  Additionally, the incumbent must ensure that the proper activities are implemented and managed in accordance with the EU GDP/GMP requirements and/or local legislation requirements (e.g. FDA, Japanese, HPRA, etc). 
 
  JOB SUMMARY - MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY / ACCOUNTABILITIES 
 
  1) Archiving completeness 
   
•   Responsible for timely archiving completeness of commercial documents, transport documents and customs documents in OpenText for GL scope of activities    
•   Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality Compliance requirements    
•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the archiving process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on archiving activities    
•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders in ensuring archiving completeness    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
•   Establishes and runs processes ensuring correctness of archived documentation    
  2) Transport documentation compliance 
   
•   Designs and orchestrates the process for conducting compliance checks of transport documents    
•   Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality compliance requirements    
•   Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on transport document compliance checks    
•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies    
•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the transport document compliance checks process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders to ensure completeness and full compliance    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
  3) Stakeholder Management 
   
•   Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience    
•   Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.    
•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit    
•   Computer skills: Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is a plus.    
  COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES 
   
•   Analytical and problem solving skills    
•   Pro-active mindset on problem solving and gap assessment    
•   Affinity with establishing structure, documentation management and compliance principles    
•   Proven track record driving positive change in a complex environment    
•   Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills based on facts, data and understanding of the regulatory requirement in complex and evolving environments; must be able to apply sound risk management    
•   Ability to prioritize, quickly synthesize information and apply regulatory requirements to a variety of scenarios    
•   Must exercise excellent judgement, make decisions based on a clear understanding of the regulatory framework, deploying strategies to conduct compliant business    
•   Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills    
•   Good communication skills and relationship builder with internal and external stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Assistant (all genders) in our EU Representation in Brussels
jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

jobs.occupation: Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) Orderpicker / Warehouse Operator - 2 Shifts | Evergem (Ghent region, ...
jobs.description:
As an essential link in our order fulfillment chain, your focus is safety, speed, and accuracy. Every day brings variety:
    
•   
Safely navigate the warehouse floor operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to pick, stage, and transfer orders.
    
•   
Execute precise loading and unloading procedures, ensuring all materials remain 100% damage-free.
    
•   
Follow structured warehouse safety protocols to stage, stack, and place incoming goods accurately.
    
•   
Support stock counting, inventory tracking, and swift shelf replenishment so goods are always ready to roll.
   

 
    
•   
Proven hands-on experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT), backed by a valid EPT certificate or license.
    
•   
Full availability and willingness to work in an alternating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
    
•   
Strong English communication skills to ensure seamless coordination and safety across the warehouse floor.
    
•   
Reliable personal transport (car, motorbike, or e-bike) to commute independently to the facility in Evergem.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

Business Development & Sales

jobs.occupation: Office manager / Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer
jobs.description:
Our client is an industrial company specialized in the manufacturing of technical products. Part of an international group, the organization offers a dynamic, hands-on environment where flexibility, autonomy, and collaboration are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer your responsibilities are:

• Act as the main point of contact for customer administrative inquiries.
• Coordinate supplier orders and monitor procurement activities.
• Organize shipments and oversee logistics operations.
• Process and monitor customer and supplier invoices.
• Support accounting administration and cash flow follow-up.
• Manage HR administration and prepare payroll-related information.
• Contribute to the ERP transition from Odoo to SAP and support process adaptation.
• Manage customer orders from receipt through to delivery.
• Client-focused mindset with excellent relationship management skills, ensuring coordination across production capacity and delivery.

A successful Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer should have:

• Proven experience as an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, or Administrative Coordinator.
• Experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
• Good understanding of sales administration, procurement, and supply chain processes.
• Comfortable managing customer orders, suppliers, and logistics coordination.
• Strong IT skills and experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Odoo and/or SAP is considered an asset.
• Fluent in French with a good command of English.
• Autonomous, organized, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
